backlog.title: Khoảng cách giữa vùng chạm nhỏ hơn8dp
verify: Measured external gaps are≥8dp in native screenshots/hierarchy.
320dp layout reflows without reducing target sizes or spacing.

backlog.title: Màn hẹp/font lớn làm chồng và tràn header
verify: At320dp width and150% type, full role is readable and no icon/text crosses its target.
All tab labels remain distinguishable; inspect at200% separately.

backlog.title: Mã enum/tiếng Anh lẫn trong giao diện nghiệp vụ
verify: Each currently observed enum renders a Vietnamese business label on list/detail/confirmation screens.
Known backend English notification templates are localized or clearly marked language-specific.

backlog.title: Kiểm tra seal vẫn yêu cầu mức hư hỏng
verify: Seal and condition checks show relevant fields/copy only.
Damage surveys retain their current severity choices and submitted notes.

backlog.title: Lịch sử giám định hiển thị rỗng trước khi tải xong
verify: Under a delayed GET, history shows loading rather than empty.
Under a failed GET, history shows a local retry; successful empty/populated results are distinct.

backlog.title: Tổng số chưa đọc được truyền nhưng không hiển thị
verify: Native header/content shows the server unread count for zero and nonzero states.
Mark-read actions update the displayed count; verify with authorized fixture state.

backlog.title: Ngày booking cần nhập timestamp thủ công
verify: User can enter a valid date/time without recalling separators.
Helper/timezone remains visible after entry and validation points to this field.

backlog.title: Chế độ sáng/tối không được lưu khi mở lại app
verify: Choose dark, close/reopen the app and retain dark with the existing auth session.
Initial unconfigured appearance follows the selected documented default/system preference.

backlog.title: Lỗi thiếu input vẫn còn sau khi đã điền
verify: Blank review produces clear field-specific messages.
Filling each required field removes its missing-field error before another submit; server failures remain visible.

backlog.title: Tiêu đề card thiếu semantics heading
verify: TalkBack heading navigation reaches each meaningful card/title once in logical order.
Ordinary content and controls remain individually reachable.

backlog.title: Chữ thông tin phụ thiếu tương phản
verify: Recompute the four named pairs at 375/768/1440px; all >=4.5:1.
Validate representative rendered pixels and exclude decoration, obscured background content and unsupported effects.

backlog.title: Tìm kiếm bản đồ bãi thiếu chỉ báo focus
verify: Shift+Tab then Tab into map search; a visible ring appears without layout shift.
Search remains keyboard usable and the ring is not clipped.

backlog.title: Form đóng và xóa input trước khi biết kết quả lưu
verify: Delay a save in a disposable fixture: keep panel and values until outcome.
Reject save: show actionable local error, preserve all input, allow retry.
Resolve save: reset/close only after success and show confirmation.

backlog.title: Thiếu trường bắt buộc nhưng handler thoát mà không chỉ lỗi
verify: Submit blank required values: visible error names each missing field and focus lands on first invalid field.
Invalid email uses type=email or equivalent accessible validation; phone uses type=tel where applicable.
Correcting input clears its stale error; error text is linked with aria-describedby and invalid state.

backlog.title: Lựa chọn role/quyền chỉ thể hiện bằng màu
verify: Accessibility tree exposes true/false selected state for every toggle.
Keyboard selection updates the state and visible styling together.
If a full tablist is adopted, implement its complete roles and keyboard behavior rather than roles alone.

backlog.title: Chi tiết Gate Pass hiển thị sai trạng thái hết hạn/hủy
verify: Fixture ACTIVE fresh/ACTIVE expired/USED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED cases: list and detail status agree.
Expired/cancelled passes have appropriate recovery text and no active Gate-out invitation.
Container 360 validity claim also considers expiry; backend remains authoritative.

backlog.title: Container 360 dùng biểu tượng thay cho QR chứa token
verify: Decode QR in both screens in a disposable fixture; decoded value equals the same qrToken.
No token/permission: display honest unavailable text and a route to dedicated Gate Pass.
Keep a readable code alternative and expiration guidance.

backlog.title: Readiness chưa biết bị trình bày như điều kiện không đạt
verify: Pending/read failure/no result/blockers/pass each produce distinct truthful content.
A network error never becomes a claimed failed business condition.
Issue remains unavailable until an explicit backend pass.

backlog.title: Giờ hết hạn mặc định của lệnh lệch giờ địa phương
verify: Freeze a clock in UTC+07 and inspect the default: exactly 24h later, not 17h.
Edit local datetime and verify serialized ISO denotes that local clock time.
Blank/invalid/past dates show a recoverable error and do not submit.

backlog.title: Việc ca truyền sai loại ID khi mở handover
verify: With two distinct handovers, opening the second review task selects the second correct handover.
No matching target displays a missing/unavailable-target state rather than silently selecting the first record.
Prefer retaining canonical entityId in work-queue mapping if a visit can have multiple handovers.

backlog.title: Shortcut tạo chuyến xe mất ngữ cảnh container
verify: Authorized Movement Order shortcut opens create with the correct container prefilled.
Gate-in shortcut selects the relevant visit and matching arrived truck when unambiguous.
Missing or multiple matching targets have explicit selection/recovery; no write occurs on navigation.

backlog.title: Điều hướng trong bộ nhớ làm mất ngữ cảnh/form
verify: Navigate A>B, use browser Back: A and its record/filter/scroll selection restore.
A copied URL or reload opens the requested authorized destination and record.
Leaving a dirty multi-field form preserves a draft or gives an explicit discard choice.

backlog.title: Một số danh sách rỗng không hướng dẫn bước tiếp theo
verify: Fixture 0 records and a nonempty collection filtered to 0 each render distinct messages.
No-results recovery clears the actual filters without initiating a write.
Loading/error/forbidden states are not described as an empty collection.

backlog.title: EDI gọi dữ liệu ví dụ sinh sẵn là payload đã truyền
verify: A generated preview is visibly and accessibly identified as illustrative before copying.
If raw payload becomes available, display exactly that payload and clearly identify its version/source.
A 20-foot/reefer fixture never labels a hardcoded 45G1 example as its transmitted raw data.

backlog.title: Trang chỉ đọc vẫn hiển thị thao tác ghi
verify: Read-only fixture users see viewing controls and clear permission context, no unusable write invitation.
Users/manage, roles/manage, billing/manage and tariff/manage controls follow exact separate permissions.
Backend authorization remains enforced on every command.

backlog.title: Popover thông báo không đóng bằng Escape/click ngoài
verify: Open panel: trigger again, real Escape and outside pointer each close.
Escape returns focus to trigger; a visible touch close route stays reachable.
Click inside keeps appropriate content interactions working and does not lock the main page.

backlog.title: Header/layout dùng literal ngoài token hiện có
verify: Affected consumers reference named tokens; literals are limited to token definitions and documented geometry.
Preserve existing layout and test both themes plus320dp/font scale1.5.

backlog.title: Cỡ chữ metadata lặp lại ngoài hệ token
verify: No repeated arbitrary font-size literals remain in the affected metadata roles.
Screenshots show equivalent hierarchy before/after; scale changes need separate review.

backlog.title: Line-height heading chưa theo rubric của dự án
verify: Heading computed line-height is1.1-1.3 where the role applies.
Long headings do not overlap or clip at all tested widths.

p2p3Policy: Not included in Phase5 unless explicitly approved. Same-file changes must remain scoped to approved P0/P1.
